workflow: independent candidate replay/approval → durable accepted source bindings → ProductionDependencies.activate(expectedPriorRelease) → verify new projection/replay → resolve VALUATION
forbiddenShortcut: This is not an ACCEPTED Head or an approval receipt; do not pass request-controlled proposals into trusted catalog

operation.reason: Owner-authorized exact TCBS 2026-10-21 EOD market/session activation (authorization not yet supplied)

rollbackRecovery.beforeActivation: Retain current immutable release plus accepted catalog/binding configuration; verify read-only replay
rollbackRecovery.atomicity: CAS projection from exact expected release; mismatch aborts, no force update
rollbackRecovery.afterFailure: Re-read active projection. If unchanged, leave baseline. If advanced, stop publication, inspect exact committed release and audit; never blindly retry
rollbackRecovery.recovery: Owner-authorized compensating release against then-current head restoring prior accepted bindings only when current validity permits. Old expired session is audit-only, not valid valuation authority. No SQL overwrite/deletion or time backdating
rollbackRecovery.postActivation: Replay full release, verify all preserved heads and MBB, resolve VALUATION using current clock; remain blocked if other authorities missing
